title: Halloween Goat Yoga at Pactamere Farm
description: Stretch with spooky vibes and playful goats at Pactamere Farm’s Halloween Goat Yoga—fun for all!
long_description:
Stretch with spooky vibes and playful goats at Pactamere Farm’s Halloween Goat Yoga—fun for all!

About this Event

Get Spooky with Halloween Goat Yoga at Pactamere Farm!Join us in person for a fun and furry twist on yoga this Halloween! Stretch, pose, and relax alongside adorable goats at beautiful Pactamere Farm. Whether you’re a yoga pro or a total newbie, this event promises laughs, good vibes, and some unforgettable memories. Don’t forget to wear your coolest costume! Ready to goat wild this Halloween? 
Come on out and enjoy some unique, goat-filled fun!
Ages 10 and up!

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Glen Allen.
